title: Mobility Equipment Safety Bulletin — Battery Work on Chairs of Home Oxygen Therapy Patients
content:
# Battery Work and Portable Oxygen — Mobility Equipment Safety Bulletin

**Bulletin.** An oxygen-safety allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty battery-set replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair when the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record is rental active or payment cap reached: 2 units when its portable equipment is a liquid oxygen portable (E0434), 1 unit when it is a portable oxygen concentrator (E1392), and nothing for any other portable equipment or when there is no such oxygen record.

## Records read

The patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record: its status, and the portable equipment code of its oxygen class. A Home Oxygen Therapy record in any status other than rental active or payment cap reached counts as no such record.

## Allowance by portable equipment

| Home Oxygen Therapy record | Portable equipment of its class | Oxygen-safety allowance |
|---|---|---|
| rental active or payment cap reached | liquid oxygen portable (E0434) | 2 units |
| rental active or payment cap reached | portable oxygen concentrator (E1392) | 1 unit |
| rental active or payment cap reached | any other portable equipment, or none | none |
| no record in either status | — | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- A patient whose Home Oxygen Therapy record reached its payment cap with a liquid oxygen portable: 2 units.
- A patient whose Home Oxygen Therapy record was returned last year: none.
